blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A low-pressure area (LPA) being monitored outside the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) could develop into a tropical depression by Tuesday or Wednesday and may enter the country’s monitoring zone by Thursday or Friday, the state weather bureau said Monday. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said in its 5 p.m. weather forecast that the LPA was located about 1,935 kilometers east of Eastern Visayas as of Monday afternoon Pagasa weather specialist Grace Castañeda-Carpio said he weather bureau is still assessing and monitoring whether conditions will become favorable enough for the LPA to strengthen in the coming days. “Mababa […]...
